meta.title: Matheus Rufca — Senior Frontend Engineer
meta.description: Senior Frontend Engineer with 15+ years of experience in React, TypeScript and modern frontend engineering. Frontend architecture, performance, testing and accessibility.

hero.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
hero.summary: 15+ years building product interfaces with React and TypeScript — currently payment and checkout flows at Disney Streaming. I work on frontend architecture, testing and accessibility, across web and Smart TV platforms.

disney.summary: Payment, checkout and billing flows for Disney's streaming products, on the Transactions & Payments team. React and Next.js against a Node.js BFF, with Playwright and Jest coverage.

fox.summary: Joined a new team building a Smart TV application from scratch in React, and contributed to migrating an existing app from LightningJS. Delivered the configuration area, station selection and shared components.

paypal.summary: On the PayPal SDK team, triaging and resolving production issues to keep the SDK reliable for the developers integrating it.

pluto.summary: On the Samsung Tizen team, building UI features and improving accessibility in a React application shipping to browsers, Smart TVs, Chromecast and consoles.

transfix.summary: Built UI features and modules for a React application backed by a GraphQL API.

sicredi.summary: Led frontend for the capital account product: micro-frontends in React, Angular and Salesforce LWC, with REST services behind a BFF layer. Ran code reviews, interviewed engineers and took part in the frontend guild.

earlier.label: Earlier
earlier.summary: Angular, AngularJS and .NET work across product teams and agencies, including Smart TV applications for LG webOS and Samsung Tizen built and published from scratch.
